description.narrative: Revised project development objective: To ensure the continuity of water service (twenty four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days a week) to the population in Greater Tunis and other targeted cities; and (ii) improve the financial viability of SONEDE.

The Urban Water Supply Project for Tunisia aims at sustaining the reliability and quality of water service in Greater Tunis and selected urban centers, through augmentation, upgrade and renewal of water supply infrastructure. It will enhance the competitiveness and sustainability o f National Public Water Supply Utility (SONEDE) operations, through modernization o f management practices and information systems, for better cost control, enhanced revenue and more responsive customer service. Project components: component 1) will implement treatment, transmission and distribution infrastructure, to strengthen water supply capacity in the Greater Tunis area. Component 2) addresses water production, storage, transmission and distribution upgrades in SONEDE's northern and central operating regions to meet demand growth. Component 3) will include studies, decision-making tools, information systems and training to enhance SONEDE'S management and planning performance.

title.narrative: Events of intermittent supply due to water shortage in the distribution systems covered by the project

comment.narrative: This indicator reflects the priority of the Government to ensuring continuity of 24 hours / 7 days water service to all SONEDE customers in the face of fast growing demand. The indicator only considers water availability (excluding repairs or rehabilitation that may be made in the distribution networks). Water cuts during summer seasons are not attributed to the project. .In Greater Tunis and Northern and Central regions, the additional volume of water produced was respectively 138 Mm3/year in Greater Tunis against an orginal target of 110 Mm3 and 63.2 Mm3/year in North and center against a target of 44.9 Mm3/year. Thus the volume of water produced exceeded the original target.

The term "total operating revenues" means revenues from all sources related to operations.". title.narrative: Direct project beneficiaries of which females

comment.narrative: This value of this indicator is cumulative. It refers to beneficiaries in areas targeted by rehabilitation and expansion works. It includes the number of household connections and beneficiary people in the targeted areas of the project works (figures are calculated on the basis on average people per household connection). The positive result is due to the operationalization of ST4 (2 m3/second)which increases the total treatment capacity of the Ghedir El Golla facility to 7.4 m3/second and thus respond to the increase in water demand. SONEDE has installed about 300,000 new household connections since 2014 in the project areas. In terms of women beneficiaries, according to the 2014 national census, women constitute 50.01% of the Tunisian population, hence the beneficiaries can be considered men and women equally. The total direct beneficiaries was 6.82 million at closing superior to the 6.8 million targeted.

title.narrative: [Additional Financing] Number of meters purchased and installed (cumulative) - Intermediate Result 3: Management Capacity Building

comment.narrative: The original target was based on the AF Results Framework. Under the restructuring, the Bank has authorized SONEDE to purchase 33,000 additional water meters on the unallocated amount of the additional financing. The delivery of these meters has been completed SONEDE has distributed the meters in its four regional districts: 4,125 in the Centre region; 8,796 in the North region; 10,884 in the South region; 9,195 in the Greater Tunis region. .More meters were purchased due to the lower price offered than the estimated value of the contract by SONEDE.In terms of their installation, according to the tender document, the initial 70,000 meters were to be delivered in four cities, namely Sousse,Sfax, Tunis (Mgrine), and Tunis (Djebel Lahmar) corresponding to the four regional directorates of SONEDE covering the entire country (Greater Tunis, North, Center, South). As such, the installation of the meters purchased with project funds can be done in 24 Governorates throughout the country.
